comparisons.name: welcome-light
comparisons.description: The whole Help capture, Aqua: the panel with its shadow as the demo opens (the welcome page of the macOS User Guide with the table of contents beside it and Welcome selected), after a click on the selected row gives the table of contents the keyboard focus it has in the capture. Masked: the two pictures of the page, which the demo replaces with pictures of the served desktop (the round picture above the title and the illustration under the rule). Everything else is scored: the text is set in the fallback font, the toolbar's glyphs are the library's system images, and the three titles the capture wraps onto two lines stay on one line in the library's outline, so the rows after them stand 16, 32 and 48 pt higher.

comparisons.name: welcome-layout-light
comparisons.description: The same with the text and the glyphs masked too: the window's title, the glyphs of Back, Forward, the sidebar button and Share, the search field's magnifier and placeholder, the titles of the table of contents (row by row for the first six, then the block of the rest, where the capture wraps three titles), the guide's title and subtitle, the Table of Contents link with its glyph, the heading and the sentence under the illustration. Scores the frame with its 3 pt corners and its shadow, the 49 pt bar and the bezels of its toolbar, the selected row, the disclosure triangles, the divider, the title block's gradient and the rule, Aqua.

comparisons.name: welcome-dark
comparisons.description: The whole Help capture, Dark Aqua: the same panel with the table of contents hidden, so the welcome page takes the window. The page is white in this appearance too; the bar is dark, and the hidden list's divider is a black line at the window's leading edge. Masked: the two pictures of the page, as in welcome-light. Whole crop otherwise: the text is in the fallback font.

comparisons.name: welcome-layout-dark
comparisons.description: As welcome-dark with the text and the glyphs masked as in welcome-layout-light, at the places they have without the table of contents: the frame and its shadow, the dark bar and its toolbar, the divider at the leading edge, the white page with the title block's gradient and the rule, Dark Aqua.

comparisons.name: search-light
comparisons.description: The whole Help-Search capture, Aqua: the results of a search for File, after a click in the search field gives it the keyboard focus and its ring, and with the pointer over the first result, which highlights its row, both as in the capture. Masked: the icon before each of the six results, which the demo replaces with the desktop's Finder icon. Whole crop otherwise: the text is in the fallback font, which wraps the second description as the capture does.

comparisons.name: search-layout-light
comparisons.description: The same with the text and the glyphs masked too: the window's title, the four toolbar glyphs, the search field's magnifier and text, All Help with the count, the title and description of each result (the second on two lines), Show all with its chevron and the line about the web with its arrow. Scores the frame and its shadow, the bar and its bezels with Back enabled and the two buttons dimmed, the focused search field with its ring and clear button, the highlighted first row and the rule, Aqua.

comparisons.name: search-dark
comparisons.description: The whole Help-Search capture, Dark Aqua: the results of the same search in the order this capture lists them, on the dark page, after a click in the search field gives it the keyboard focus. No row is highlighted: the pointer is over none. Masked: the icon before each of the six results, as in search-light. Whole crop otherwise: the text is in the fallback font.

comparisons.name: search-layout-dark
comparisons.description: As search-dark with the text and the glyphs masked as in search-layout-light, at the places of this capture's rows: the frame and its shadow, the dark bar and its toolbar, the focused search field, the dark page and the rule, Dark Aqua.
